findings.summary: Inventory gate omits the frozen malformed-application eligibility cases
findings.evidence: inventory() covers eight ordinary saturated primitives and a one-argument partial application, but has no later-saturation, over-application, labelled operand, or None-in-original-slot-2 with later arguments fixture. fixture_probe only mutates annotations, locations and identifier spelling. Thus the passing inventory gate does not exercise AC-4's original-slot and accumulated eligibility-reason obligations; removing unsupported_labels or shifting a missing slot would not be detected by these fixtures.
findings.fix: Extend the private typed-tree fixture seam and CHECK-1 with each frozen unusual application shape. Assert immediate-site cardinality, original slot-2 metadata, UNSUPPORTED precedence and the exact accumulated sorted eligibility reasons, including combinations with unsupported ancestry.

findings.summary: Report oracle accepts semantic reasons contradicting site status
findings.evidence: validateReport checks reason vocabulary and sorting but never status-to-reason correspondence or an exclusion reason for UNSUPPORTED. A read-only sensitivity experiment loaded the actual validator, obtained the actual Guard_domain CMT report, replaced its UNSUPPORTED site's reasons with only divisor_nonzero_if_reached, and the validator accepted it (exit 0). numeric() checks statuses without reasons. reportMode also compares text only for one MAY_ZERO fixture and census, omitting per-site artifact/id/reason equivalence across all five statuses required by C-16/FR-033.
findings.fix: Require the exact conditional reason for each numeric status and at least one applicable exclusion reason for unsupported sites. Compare every text site against JSON artifact/id/status/primitive/reasons on a multi-site fixture containing all five statuses, and add sensitivity controls showing mismatched reasons and omitted text fields fail.

findings.summary: Public analysis resets compiler-global load-path state without restoring the caller's configuration
findings.evidence: Arch_guard.render_json/render_text are installed public entry points and call Guard_interpreter.analyze. analyze invokes Load_path.init with only Config.standard_library and Envaux.reset_cache. Compiler-libs documents Load_path.init as reset followed by adding only supplied paths. A compiler-only owned client initialized a fresh marker path, called render_json on the already-built owned arch_index.cmt, and printed before_marker=true after_marker=false (compile exit 0, run exit 0).
findings.fix: Prefer keeping the analyzer process-isolated behind the CLI unless in-process composability is explicitly required. If it is required, define the contract, encapsulate and serialize all compiler-global mutation, and test success/exception restoration. Restoring get_paths plus resetting Envaux caches is incomplete by itself because the auto-include callback and Envaux cache state are separate mutable globals.
findings.boundary: installed arch-index.guard render API to host compiler-libs process
findings.invariant: A public library call must not silently destroy compiler-global lookup configuration owned by its caller.
findings.failure_mode: Subsequent host environment reconstruction or compiler lookup fails or resolves differently because only the standard-library path remains.
findings.fingerprint_v2: installed arch-index.guard render API to host compiler-libs process|A public library call must not silently destroy compiler-global lookup configuration owned by its caller.|Subsequent host environment reconstruction or compiler lookup fails or resolves differently because only the standard-library path remains.

findings.summary: Text reports omit mandatory compiler and trusted-build assumptions
findings.evidence: FR-036 requires every successful report to record linked compiler version, trusted same-compiler/target and no-source-freshness assumptions, and interprocedural/heap limitations. render_text prints only input count/int_bits, sites, census and a shorter global warning (lines 213-228); these required fields remain only in analysis_json/tool JSON. C-5 also requires an explicit indirect-operations/omitted-artifacts limitation in both formats; neither renderer includes it.
findings.fix: Project compiler metadata and all required assumptions/limitations from the shared result into text; include the explicit C-5 exclusions in shared limitations and assert them in both renderers.

findings.summary: Immediate-application shape and operand-type obligations are only partially tested
findings.evidence: Inventory tests cover a partial primitive with absent slot 2, native fixtures, aliases and shadow spelling. They do not exercise a later-saturated immediate application, explicit None second slot with further arguments, labelled/over-applied known primitives, accumulated eligibility defects, or unresolved/non-native operands of native primitives/zero guards. The fixture probe rewrites only annotation/location/spelling, not these shapes. These are explicit AC-4/AC-5 obligations, not inferred extra precision.
findings.fix: Extend the private trusted fixture seam for inaccessible application/type shapes and invoke the actual CLI, asserting exact inventory, original slot, eligibility reasons and conservative guard behavior.

findings.summary: Scope, fresh-entry and accumulated unsupported-reason criteria lack required cases
findings.evidence: The 26 numeric cases and twelve-site fixture do not exercise alpha-renaming or aliases before/inside a refined guard; sticky unsupported ancestry through nested/curried/immediately applied functions; defaults containing target sites; multiple unsupported causes; later supported siblings; targets in loop conditions/bounds; or the full application dispatch categories. numeric() asserts statuses and census but never exact semantic/unsupported reason arrays. AC-11 through AC-16 explicitly require these cases.
findings.fix: Add bounded owned native fixtures for binding-time alias values, function entry/reset and lexical ancestry, all loop expression positions, effect/method/unlisted dispatch, and assert exact closed reasons with precedence and unaffected siblings.

findings.summary: Report and boundary checks omit explicit acceptance obligations
findings.evidence: reportMode checks census substrings and a single MAY_ZERO primitive/location, not every site's artifact/id/status/primitive/reasons against text. It lacks duplicate coordinates and 256-byte/257-byte UTF-8 spelling cases; inventory compares parsed objects for a repeat of one path, not reversed distinct accepted input bytes. Help/version and root wrapper behavior have no regression test. AC-1/AC-3/AC-7/AC-19 require these behaviors.
findings.fix: Add byte-level reversed multi-input checks, full same-fixture semantic text/JSON comparisons, duplicate-coordinate and UTF-8 boundary fixtures, CLI/wrapper contract controls.
